info.description:
> ⚠️ **Active development — not for production use yet.** This app is under active development. Although it may carry a stable release status, **please do not use it in production environments before 12 June 2026.** See the [app page on conduction.nl](https://conduction.nl/apps/larpingapp) for release planning and what this app does.
📰 A management tool for larp organisation
**Requires:** [OpenRegister](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/openregister) (install from the [Nextcloud App Store](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/openregister)).
Larping provides a tool to manage your setting
- 📲 Create skills, items, conditions - 🔄 Manage characters - 🆓 Automatically calculate abilities and XP - Manage backgrounds, approve characters - Handle event subscription and experience score
Requirements can be found [here](https://larping.app/installatie) The Roadmap is available [here](https://github.com/orgs/LarpingApp/projects/1/views/2) Create a [bug report](https://github.com/LarpingApp/.github/issues/new/choose) Create a [feature request](https://github.com/LarpingApp/.github/issues/new/choose)
